instruction: My spotify premium membership just expired yesterday. Renew it for the same duration.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The agent must discover the duration of the just-expired premium subscription via show_premium_subscriptions (static facts latest-subscription / subscription-duration encode that the latest record determines the target duration; known-duration is only ever asserted for that duration, so the planner is forced to resubscribe with the same duration). A payment card id is looked up with show_payment_cards before subscribe_premium. The gmail/file_system record changes in the evaluation are automatic side effects of subscribe_premium (receipt email) and need no actions. supervisor-complete-task carries a non-API ?d parameter only to express the goal condition (subscribed-premium same-duration) in its precondition; complete_task is called with no answer. The reference solution lists 7 calls; this model yields 6 (an optional show_premium_plans / supervisor.show_payment_cards lookup is omitted as unnecessary).
